label: spouse
description: The subject has the object as their legal spouse (husband, wife, etc.).

label: position held
description: The office, position, or public role that the subject currently or formerly held; not to be confused with P97 (noble title), which refers to hereditary or honorific ranks.

label: noble title
description: A hereditary, honorific, or royal rank held by the subject; not to be confused with P39 (position held), which refers to political or administrative offices.

label: award received
description: An award or other formal recognition received by a person, organisation, or creative work.

label: creator
description: The person or organisation who created or originated the work, object, or other item.

label: doctoral advisor
description: The person who supervised the subject's doctoral or PhD thesis (also known as thesis advisor or PhD supervisor).

label: votes received
description: The number or share of votes the subject received in an election or vote, expressed as a count or percentage.

label: participant in
description: An event or process in which a person, organisation, or creative work participates.

label: winner
description: The subject who won a competition or similar event; not to be used for awards (use P166 instead).

label: ranking
description: The ordinal or ranking position of the subject in a list, competition, or group.

label: parent
description: The subject has the object as their parent.
